data.held: The circular was valid. Treaty shopping did not make the India–Mauritius treaty invalid, and a Mauritius tax residency certificate was enough evidence of residence to claim treaty benefits.
Grounds to resist a foreign award under section 48 are narrow, and the enforcement court does not review the merits of the dispute.

A right of first refusal that would bind the player after the contract ended was, prima facie, a restraint of trade and void under section 27 of the Indian Contract Act (an interim-stage ruling; the clause was valid during the term).

To decide disparagement, a court looks at the intent of the ad, how it is made, and its storyline and message. Viewing the ad as a whole, the division bench took the prima facie view that it disparaged Pepsi.

Labour alone (“sweat of the brow”) does not create copyright; a derivative work needs skill and judgment with a minimal degree of creativity. The raw text of judgments stays free to copy, but the publisher’s paragraph splitting, internal paragraph numbering and marking of concurring or dissenting opinions were protected.

Privacy is a fundamental right, protected as part of life and liberty under Article 21 and the freedoms in Part III. The opinions explain that any limit on it must be backed by law, pursue a legitimate aim and be proportionate.
